content.what_it_is: MATLAB eight-panel comparison plot for one selected output (35): it loads propeller and no-propeller eta, concentration, suspended-load change, and bed-load change arrays; plots the four no-propeller fields in the left column and corresponding propeller fields in the right column; and writes compare.jpg (L1-L126). Concentrations are multiplied by 100 and labeled percent, while eta and sediment-change panels use fixed ranges (L39-L123).

no-propeller directory fdir1 defined at L3
depth array dep loaded at L6
grid dimensions n and m defined at L8
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L10-L11
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L12-L13
selected output vector nfile defined at L17
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L20-L21
loop index num defined at L26
formatted suffix fnum defined at L28
propeller arrays eta/ch/ds/db loaded at L29-L32
no-propeller arrays eta1/ch1/ds1/db1 loaded at L34-L37

unresolved: Cross-run shape/alignment assumption across L6-L13 and L29-L40: all eight arrays from two directories are plotted on coordinates derived only from the propeller dep_00000, with no dimension or registration check.

Latent multi-file state defect across L17, L23, L26, and L39-L123: nfile is represented as a vector and looped, but clf occurs only before the loop and every panel sets hold on. If more than one index is configured, fields/colorbars accumulate and only one final compare.jpg is written, overlaying multiple outputs rather than producing separate comparisons.
No mask or finite-value handling is applied to any of the eight fields before fixed caxis rendering, so sentinel/dry values can enter the panels.
MATLAB pcolor in all eight panels ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces.
